Render a table with kableExtra styling

Source: R/tab.R
tab.Rd

Convenience wrapper around kableExtra::kbl() and kableExtra::kable_styling() for quick, consistently formatted HTML tables in R Markdown/Quarto output.

Usage

tab(x, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

x

A data frame, matrix, or other object accepted by kbl().

digits

Number of decimal places for numeric columns. Default 3.

...

Additional arguments passed to kbl().

Value

A styled kableExtra table object.

Examples

tab(head(mtcars))
#> <table class="table table-striped table-hover table-condensed" style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;">
